updates.title: Mobile UI polish: scrollable tab bar + smaller sign-in signature
updates.notes: The bottom navigation now scrolls smoothly on phones instead of cramming every tab into one row, so the labels no longer overlap or wrap. The Canaan AI signature on the sign-in screen is also smaller so it no longer overshadows the login form. No data or feature changes — everything continues to sync as before. Tap Install update, then open the downloaded file to install over your current version.
